successors.name: Sultanate of Ternate
successors.text: Jailolo Bay and its royal seat on western Halmahera

ledger.x: 13th century (uncertain): Jailolo, one of the four kingdoms of Maluku, strong by 1250 per Valentijn; 1300 is a bridging year.
1551: Jailolo falls after a siege by the Portuguese and Sultan Hairun and is vassalized by Ternate.
1551: independence ends; Katarabumi loses the kingly title.

certainty.note: Founding date and extent uncertain; no frontier on the page.
